Book.title: The Jukebox Masterclass
Book.author: Lizzie
Book.Page:
Welcome to the Jukebox Mod!
Power the Jukebox with [FF0000]10 Watts[-], then use it to browse the tracks unlocked in that machine.
Find a Walkman and keep it in your inventory. Use a cassette from your inventory to play it through the Walkman. Cassettes are reusable.
Aim a music disc at a powered Jukebox and use it to install the track. The disc is consumed, and the track remains unlocked for that Jukebox after saving and loading.
The first player to install a disc becomes the Jukebox owner. Owners can set a Duke price for visitors from the Jukebox Library, while their own playback is always free.
